messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up — I noticed our /v1/generate API reference still uses `prompt` in the JSON examples and an array request body in one spot. That contradicts the schema which expects an object with `input`.

riley: Which doc file? Link?

jordan: docs/reference/generate.md and openapi/examples/generate-example.json. Current snippet: `[{\"prompt\":\"Write a haiku\"}]`. Should be `{\"input\":\"Write a haiku\"}`.

samir: Good catch. Our snippet extraction produces SDK examples; if we leave the array it will generate broken JS/Go calls. I'll hold off on publishing the SDK patch until docs change lands.

marta: Flagging also that the response example shows `text` as a plain string (`\"text\": \"ok\"`) but the response schema uses `choices: [{\"text\": ...}]`. Please update both request and response examples.

jordan: I'll open a docs-only PR with the fixes + a tiny migration note at the top: \"Previously some examples used an array body; use {\"input\":...} in the current API.\" Will not rename params (keeping `max_new_tokens`).

luis: Friendly reminder: update snippets/js/generate.snippet.ts and snippets/python/generate_example.py so site shows correct inline examples.

ci-bot: examples-lint failed on docs/reference/generate.md:45 - response shape mismatch. See CI: https://ci.redwood/linters/10234

riley: After you push, I'll check openapi/examples/generate-example.json — the static site pulls that directly.

jordan: PR opened at 1729998920: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2460. Changes: request body -> object, response -> choices array, migration note added, snippets updated.

samir: I'll update extraction mapping after merge and open the SDK PR referencing this commit.

marta: Quick review checklist for PR: changed files, migration note, kept `max_new_tokens`, ran `yarn docs:build`, smoke-check rendered page. If all green I'll merge.

jordan: Merged at 1729998999. Closing follow-up issue #602. Thanks for quick turnaround.
